ice.definition:
n. water frozen in the solid state
n. the frozen part of a body of water
n. diamonds
n. a frozen dessert with fruit flavoring (especially one containing no milk)
ice.translation: n. 冰, 冰淇淋, 糖衣, 冷若冰霜, 矜持, 贿赂\nvt. 使结冰, 冰镇, 覆以糖衣\nvi. 结冰

examples.en: If you buy me an ice cream, I'll kiss you.
examples.zh: 如果你买给我冰淇淋，我就亲你一下。

examples.en: The ice was thick enough for me to walk on.
examples.zh: 冰厚得足以让我在上面走路。

examples.en: The heat is making me crave for an ice cream.
examples.zh: 热得想吃冰淇淋。

idea.definition: n. the content of cognition; the main thing you are thinking about\nn. a personal view
idea.translation: n. 主意, 办法, 理想, 思想, 概念, 意见\n[医] 观念, 思想

examples.en: I have no idea of how to send a fax.
examples.zh: 我不知道如何传真。

examples.en: I told Tom I thought it was a good idea.
examples.zh: 我和汤姆说了，我觉得这个主意很好。

examples.en: I have no idea how he made all that money.
examples.zh: 我不知道他是怎么赚来那么多钱的。

ideal.definition:
n. the idea of something that is perfect; something that one hopes to attain
n. model of excellence or perfection of a kind; one having no equal
s. conforming to an ultimate standard of perfection or excellence; embodying an ideal
s. constituting or existing only in the form of an idea or mental image or conception
ideal.translation: n. 理想, 典范, 观念, 思想, 最后目标\na. 理想的, 完美的, 空想的, 观念的, 唯心论的

examples.en: The beach is an ideal place for children to play.
examples.zh: 海滩是一个供孩子们玩乐的理想场所。

examples.en: There couldn’t be a more ideal solution than that.
examples.zh: 再没有比这更如意的办法了。

examples.en: A warm, sunny day is ideal for a picnic.
examples.zh: 温暖的晴天最适合野餐。

ideally.translation: adv. 完美地, 理想地

examples.en: Ideally, a candidate for this job should have four years' work experience.
examples.zh: 我们希望应聘者能有4年工作经验。

identical.definition:
s. exactly alike; incapable of being perceived as different
s. being the exact same one; not any other:
a. (of twins) derived from a single egg or ovum
s. having properties with uniform values along all axes
identical.translation: a. 同一的, 恒等的, 完全相同的\n[医] 同一的, 同等的

examples.en: He is identical to his older brother.
examples.zh: 他跟哥哥一模一样。

examples.en: No two words are identical in meaning.
examples.zh: 每一个字的意思都是独特的。

identification.definition: n. evidence of identity; something that identifies a person or thing\nn. the condition of having the identity (of a person or object) established\nn. the attribution to yourself (consciously or unconsciously) of the characteristics of another person (or group of persons)
identification.translation: n. 识别, 身份证明, 认同\n[化] 鉴定; 鉴别; 鉴别法; 认证

examples.en: Do you have your student identification card?
examples.zh: 你有学生证吗？

identify.definition:
v. recognize as being; establish the identity of someone or something
v. consider (oneself) as similar to somebody else
v. conceive of as united or associated
v. identify as in botany or biology, for example
identify.translation: vt. 识别, 认为...等同于, 确定, 使参与\nvi. 一致, 认同

examples.en: You can identify children's voices without any problem.
examples.zh: 你可以毫无问题地辨别孩子们的声音。

examples.en: She identified him as the murderer.
examples.zh: 她确认他是杀人凶手。

examples.en: They identified the risk factors.
examples.zh: 他们确认了风险因素。

identity.definition:
n. the distinct personality of an individual regarded as a persisting entity
n. the individual characteristics by which a thing or person is recognized or known
n. an operator that leaves unchanged the element on which it operates
n. exact sameness
identity.translation: n. 身份, 相同, 一致, 特性, 恒等式\n[计] (打)标记, 标识

examples.en: A student should not lose sight of his own identity.
examples.zh: 学生不该忽略自己的身份。

examples.en: We know the identity of Tom's killer.
examples.zh: 我们知道汤姆的杀手是谁。

examples.en: Sir, please present your passport or identity card, so I can register it.
examples.zh: 先生，请出示护照或者身份证，让我登记一下。

ideology.translation: n. 思想体系, 意识形态, 观念学, 空论\n[医] 观念学, 观念形态

examples.en: This is the ideology to which my speech is written.
examples.zh: 我的演讲稿就是依据这个理论写的。

examples.en: The heart of Esperanto ideology is the equality of all languages and cultures.
examples.zh: 世界语的思想核心在于一切语言文化的平等。

examples.en: In its more extreme variants, cis ideology can include denial of the empirical reality of intersex and transgender people.
examples.zh: 在更极端的变体中，顺性别意识形态可能包括否认阴阳人和跨性别者的现实经历。

idiom.definition: n. an expression whose meanings cannot be inferred from the meanings of the words that make it up
idiom.translation: n. 习语, 成语, 惯用语法, 方言

examples.en: "Having a clear conscience" is an idiom.
examples.zh: 问心无愧是一个成语。

idle.definition:
n. the state of an engine or other mechanism that is idling
v. run disconnected or idle
v. be idle; exist in a changeless situation
a. not in action or at work
idle.translation:
a. 懒惰的, 闲散的, 停顿的, 空闲的, 无用的
vi. 无所事事, 闲散, 浪费, 空转
vt. 虚度, 使闲散, 使空转
n. 空转, 空闲时间
[计] 空闲时间

examples.en: It's wasteful to leave the land lying idle.
examples.zh: 让土地闲置著很浪费。

examples.en: Jim works hard, but John is idle.
examples.zh: 吉姆工作努力，而约翰却无所事事。

examples.en: I spent idle days during the vacation.
examples.zh: 假期里，我度过了悠闲的日子。

if.definition: conj. In case that; granting, allowing, or supposing that; --\n   introducing a condition or supposition.\nconj. Whether; -- in dependent questions.
if.translation: conj. 如果, 是否, 无论何时, 假设, 即使\nn. 条件\n[计] DOS批处理命令:根据所测试的条件决定是否执行另一条命令

examples.en: If I were a bird, I could fly to you.
examples.zh: 如果我是一只小鸟，我就可以飞到你的身边了。

examples.en: If I knew it, I would tell it to you.
examples.zh: 我要是知道就告诉你了。

examples.en: If he can do that, I will eat my hat.
examples.zh: 他要是成了，我跟你姓。

ignorance.definition: n. the lack of knowledge or education
ignorance.translation: n. 无知, 愚味\n[法] 无知, 不知情, 愚昧

examples.en: War is peace. Freedom is slavery. Ignorance is strength.
examples.zh: 战争即和平，自由即奴役，无知即力量。

examples.en: Ignorance is the mother of fear as well as of admiration.
examples.zh: 无知是恐惧之母，也是崇拜之母。

examples.en: The world's evil almost always comes from ignorance.
examples.zh: 世上的罪恶差不多总是由愚昧无知造成的。

ignorant.definition: s. uneducated in general; lacking knowledge or sophistication\ns. uneducated in the fundamentals of a given art or branch of learning; lacking knowledge of a specific field\ns. unaware because of a lack of relevant information or knowledge
ignorant.translation: a. 无知识的, 不知道的, 由无知产生的\n[法] 无知的, 愚昧的, 不知情的

examples.en: I am quite ignorant of the plan.
examples.zh: 我对这个计划一无所知。

examples.en: I am quite ignorant of their plan.
examples.zh: 他们的计划我一无所知。

examples.en: Many economists are ignorant of that fact.
examples.zh: 很多经济学家都不知道这点。

ignore.definition: v. refuse to acknowledge\nv. fail to notice\nv. be ignorant of or in the dark about
ignore.translation: vt. 不理睬, 忽视, 驳回, 忽略\n[计] 忽略

examples.en: If I were you, I would ignore it.
examples.zh: 如果我是你，我就忽略它。

examples.en: It wouldn't be wise to ignore Tom completely.
examples.zh: 完全忽视汤姆不会是明智的。

examples.en: Facts do not cease to exist because they are ignored.
examples.zh: 不是因为某人不理事实它们就会不复存在了。

ill.definition:
a. affected by an impairment of normal physical or mental function
s. resulting in suffering or adversity
s. distressing
s. indicating hostility or enmity
ill.translation: n. 疾病, 坏事, 罪恶, 灾难\na. 生病的, 邪恶的, 不吉利的, 敌意的, 不良的, 不顺利的\nadv. 有害地, 不幸地, 几乎不

examples.en: He seems to have been ill for a long time.
examples.zh: 他好像已经病了很久了。

examples.en: He is the last person to speak ill of others.
examples.zh: 他绝不是说人坏话的人。

examples.en: They called in a doctor because the child was ill.
examples.zh: 他们打电话给医生因为这个孩子生病了。

illegal.definition: a. prohibited by law or by official or accepted rules
illegal.translation: a. 违法的, 不合规定的\n[经] 非法的, 犯规的

examples.en: I am suspicious that this is an illegal taxi.
examples.zh: 我怀疑这是辆黑车。

examples.en: Bicycles traveling to the right of automobiles is illegal.
examples.zh: 自行车在汽车的右侧行驶是不合法的。

examples.en: "Is it an illegal taxi?" I ask him.
examples.zh: “是黑车吗？”我问他。

illiterate.definition: n. a person unable to read\na. not able to read or write\na. lacking culture, especially in language and literature
illiterate.translation: n. 文盲\na. 目不识丁的, 没受教育的

examples.en: He was an orphan and illiterate.
examples.zh: 他是个孤儿，而且不识字。

illness.definition: n. impairment of normal physiological function affecting part or all of an organism
illness.translation: n. 疾病, 恶意\n[医] 病

examples.en: I believe this type of medicine will help your illness.
examples.zh: 我相信这种药对你的病情有帮助。

examples.en: He was absent from school on account of illness.
examples.zh: 他因为生病没来上课。

examples.en: He could not come because of his serious illness.
examples.zh: 他因为生重病不能来。

illuminate.definition: v. add embellishments and paintings to (medieval manuscripts)
illuminate.translation: vt. 照明, 用灯装饰, 阐明, 说明, 使灿烂\nvi. 照亮, 用灯装饰

examples.en: Thousands of candles illuminated the church during the ceremony.
examples.zh: 数以千计的蜡烛点亮了仪式中的教堂。

examples.en: Sun lights the landscape, pain illuminates the soul.
examples.zh: 阳光照亮田野，痛苦点亮心灵。

examples.en: The room was illuminated with red lights.
examples.zh: 这个房间被红色的灯照亮了。

illusion.definition: n. an erroneous mental representation\nn. something many people believe that is false
illusion.translation: n. 幻影, 错觉, 幻想\n[医] 错觉

examples.en: He had the illusion that he was a genius.
examples.zh: 他幻想自己是个天才。

examples.en: A mirror wall in the room creates an illusion of spaciousness.
examples.zh: 房间里的镜面墙营造出宽敞的错觉。

examples.en: Everything you saw was an illusion.
examples.zh: 你看到的都是幻觉。

illustrate.definition: v. depict with an illustration\nv. supply with illustrations
illustrate.translation: vt. 举例说明, 作图解, 阐明\nvi. 举例说明

examples.en: The artist who illustrated this book is very good.
examples.zh: 给这本书画插画的画家很好。

examples.en: The workflow is illustrated in the following chart.
examples.zh: 下面的图标显示了这个流程图

examples.en: We have illustrated the story with pictures.
examples.zh: 我们给这个故事配了插图。

illustration.definition: n. artwork that helps make something clear or attractive\nn. a visual representation (a picture or diagram) that is used make some subject more pleasing or easier to understand
illustration.translation: n. 例证, 插图\n[化] 插图

examples.en: This book has a lot of illustrations.
examples.zh: 这本书有很多插图。

examples.en: To give a definition of a word is more difficult than to give an illustration of its usage.
examples.zh: 要为一个字下定义比为字的用法举例更困难。

image.definition:
n. an iconic mental representation
n. (mathematics) the set of values of the dependent variable for which a function is defined
n. the general impression that something (a person or organization or product) presents to the public
v. render visible, as by means of MRI
image.translation:
n. 影像, 肖像, 想象, 图像, 形象, 翻版
vt. 作...的像, 反映, 想象, 象征
n. 图像
[计] 图象

examples.en: Choose a suitable satellite image as the base map.
examples.zh: 选择合适的卫星图做为底图。

examples.en: Please select a language for the Image Viewer interface.
examples.zh: 请为Image Viewer的界面选择语言。

examples.en: The image quality is really bad - the resolution is so low.
examples.zh: 画质真的很差 - 分辨率那么低。

imaginary.definition: n (mathematics) a number of the form a+bi where a and b are real numbers and i is the square root of -1\ns not based on fact; unreal
imaginary.translation: a. 想像的, 虚构的, 假想的

examples.en: All the events described in this story are imaginary.
examples.zh: 故事里发生的事都是虚构出来的。

examples.en: Some scientists believe that the greenhouse effect is imaginary.
examples.zh: 有的科学家认为温室效应是虚构的。

examples.en: You say Nessie is an imaginary being, but I think she exists.
examples.zh: 你说尼斯湖水怪是虚构的，但我觉得它真实存在。

imagination.definition: n. the formation of a mental image of something that is not perceived as real and is not present to the senses\nn. the ability to form mental images of things or events
imagination.translation: n. 想像, 听觉, 想像力\n[医] 想像

examples.en: This is beyond the scope of my imagination.
examples.zh: 这超出了我的想像范围。

examples.en: I want you to use your imagination.
examples.zh: 我想你用自己的想象力。

examples.en: We are encouraged to use our imagination.
examples.zh: 我们被鼓励使用想像力。

imagine.definition: v. form a mental image of something that is not present or that is not the case
imagine.translation: vt. 想像, 设想, 猜测\nvi. 想像起来

examples.en: Can you imagine what the 21st century will be like?
examples.zh: 你能想象21世纪会是甚么样吗？

examples.en: Today, nobody can imagine a life without a TV.
examples.zh: 现在没有人能想像一个没有电视的生活。

examples.en: Today no one can imagine a life without television.
examples.zh: 今天没有人能想像一个没有电视的生活。

imitate.definition: v. reproduce someone's behavior or looks\nv. appear like, as in behavior or appearance\nv. make a reproduction or copy of
imitate.translation: vt. 模仿, 效法, 冒充, 仿造

examples.en: Children imitate their peers rather than their parents.
examples.zh: 比起父母，儿童更喜欢模仿自己的同龄人。

examples.en: A parrot can imitate the human voice.
examples.zh: 鹦鹉会模仿人的声音。

examples.en: A parrot can imitate human speech.
examples.zh: 鹦鹉会模仿人的声音。

immediate.definition:
s. of the present time and place
a. having no intervening medium
s. immediately before or after as in a chain of cause and effect
s. performed with little or no delay
immediate.translation: a. 立即的, 直接的, 接近的\n[医] 直接的, 立即的

examples.en: His speech won the immediate applause of the audience.
examples.zh: 他的演说赢得了观众热烈的掌声。

examples.en: They needed to make a decision - an immediate decision.
examples.zh: 他们需要做决定——即刻作出决定。

immediately.definition: r. without delay or hesitation; with no time intervening\nr. near or close by\nr. bearing an immediate relation
immediately.translation: adv. 直接地, 立刻, 立即

examples.en: Had I the money, I would immediately acquire this computer.
examples.zh: 我要是有钱，立马就买这台电脑。

examples.en: We took action immediately so that things wouldn't get worse.
examples.zh: 为了避免情况恶化，我们马上采取了行动。

examples.en: Immediately after it caught fire, the chemical factory blew up.
examples.zh: 化学工厂一着火就爆炸了。

immense.definition: s unusually great in size or amount or degree or especially extent or scope
immense.translation: a. 极广大的, 无边的, 非常好的

examples.en: The teachers are all continuing to teach despite the immense pressure.
examples.zh: 老师们都顶著巨大的压力在坚持上课。

immerse.definition: v. thrust or throw into\nv. enclose or envelop completely, as if by swallowing
immerse.translation: vt. 沉浸, 使陷入\n[医] 浸[入]

examples.en: He is totally immersed in family life and has no wish to work.
examples.zh: 他完全沉浸于家庭生活中，不想工作了。

immigrant.definition: n. a person who comes to a country where they were not born in order to settle there
immigrant.translation: n. 移民\na. 移入的, 移民的

examples.en: The immigrants entered the country in a steady flow.
examples.zh: 移民川流不息地进入这个国家。

examples.en: Many of the immigrants changed their names.
examples.zh: 许多移民改了名字。

examples.en: America is a land of immigrants.
examples.zh: 美国是一个移民国家。

immigration.definition: n. migration into a place (especially migration to a country of which you are not a native in order to settle there)\nn. the body of immigrants arriving during a specified interval
immigration.translation: n. 移民, 移居\n[医] 移民

examples.en: Please let me see your passport, also did you complete the immigration form?
examples.zh: 请你把护照出示给我看看，还有入境表格填好了吗？

imminent.definition: s close in time; about to occur
imminent.translation: a. 即将来临的, 逼近的

examples.en: The President's words overshadowed the imminent threat of Global Warming.
We think that Tom might be in imminent danger.
According to the radio, a storm is imminent in the North.

immoral.definition: a. deliberately violating accepted principles of right and wrong
immoral.translation: a. 不道德的, 邪恶的, 放荡的\n[法] 不道德的, 道德败坏的, 邪恶的

examples.en: It's not immoral for a novelist to tell lies. In fact, the bigger the lies, the better lies, and the more the common folks and critics will praise you.
examples.zh: 小说家说谎并不是不道德的事。其实，谎话说得愈离谱、愈有技巧，就愈会受到公众和批评家的表扬。

immune.definition:
n. a person who is immune to a particular infection
a. relating to the condition of immunity
s. secure against
s. relating to or conferring immunity (to disease or infection)
immune.translation: a. 免疫的, 免除的, 不受影响的\nn. 免疫者

examples.en: Everybody is immune to smallpox nowadays.
examples.zh: 现今每个人都对天花免疫了。

examples.en: Every person in this community is like a cell in the immune system of a healthy human body.
examples.zh: 这个团体内的每个人，像是一个健康的人体内免疫系统里的细胞。

immunity.definition: n. (medicine) the condition in which an organism can resist disease\nn. the quality of being unaffected by something
immunity.translation: n. 免疫, 免疫性, 免除\n[化] 免疫性

examples.en: His diplomatic passport entitles him to immunity from criminal prosecution.
He couldn't be charged because he had diplomatic immunity.
People get vaccinated to create immunity against a disease.

impact.definition: n. the striking of one body against another\nn. a forceful consequence; a strong effect\nv. press or wedge together; pack together
impact.translation: n. 冲击, 冲突, 影响, 效果\nvt. 挤入, 撞击, 压紧, 对...发生影响

examples.en: The blizzard has already had a severe impact on the economy.
examples.zh: 这场暴风雪已经对经济造成了很严重的影响。

examples.en: They have no impact on the environment.
examples.zh: 它们对环境一点都没有影响。

examples.en: This incident has made a great impact on the progress of the project.
examples.zh: 这个事件极大影响了项目进度。

impair.definition: v. make worse or less effective
impair.translation: vt. 损害, 减少, 削弱\n[法] 损害, 伤害, 减少

examples.en: Social media could greatly impair the intelligence of our kids.
My sister works at a school for visually impaired children.
Your insight is poor and your judgment is impaired.

impairment.definition: n. damage that results in a reduction of strength or quality
impairment.translation: n. 削弱, 减少, 损害, 损伤, 危害\n[计] 减损

examples.en: The impairment cannot bring them to lose their willingness to live.
This has visual impairment as a side effect.
Yanni's visual impairment makes him more vulnerable.

impart.definition: v. transmit (knowledge or skills)\nv. transmit or serve as the medium for transmission
impart.translation: vt. 给予, 传授, 告知

examples.en: Let me impart these few words of wisdom to you.
He wants to impart his wisdom to you.
Will you impart the secret to me?

impartial.translation: a. 公平的, 不偏不倚的\n[法] 公正无私的, 不偏袒的, 公平的

examples.en: He puts on a show of being impartial and unbiased, but I think he's just a guy with no opinion of his own.
examples.zh: 他总在别人面前装出大公无私的样子，但依我看，他只不过是个没有主见的家伙。

impatient.definition: a. restless or short-tempered under delay or opposition\ns. (usually followed by `to') full of eagerness
impatient.translation: a. 不耐烦的, 着急的, 急切的

examples.en: I'm very impatient to see the new version of Tatoeba.
examples.zh: 我迫不及待地想要看到Tatoeba的新版本。

examples.en: I think that Tom is a bit too impatient.
examples.zh: 我觉得汤姆有些过于性急了。

examples.en: Tom told me he thought Mary would be impatient.
examples.zh: 汤姆告诉我，他以为玛莉会有耐心。

imperative.definition: n. some duty that is essential and urgent\na. requiring attention or action\na. relating to verbs in the imperative mood
imperative.translation: n. 命令, 必要的事, 规则, 祈使语气\na. 命令式的, 急需的, 势在必行的, 强制的

examples.en: It is imperative for you to act at once.
examples.zh: 你必须马上行动。

examples.en: It is imperative for you to finish by Sunday.
examples.zh: 你必须在星期日前完成。

imperial.definition:
n. a small tufted beard worn by Emperor Napoleon III
n. a piece of luggage carried on top of a coach
a. relating to or associated with an empire
a. of or belonging to the British Imperial System of weights and measures
imperial.translation: a. 帝王的, 宗主国的, 至尊的, 壮丽的\nn. 特等品

examples.en: Aristocrats lived to the east and west of the imperial palace.
examples.zh: 贵族住在故宫的东边和西边。

examples.en: Meet me at the lobby of the Imperial Hotel at 6:30 p.m.
examples.zh: 下午六点半到帝国酒店的大堂找我。

examples.en: During the 15th century, the Ryukyu Kingdom was a tributary state of Imperial China.
examples.zh: 在15世纪，琉球王国是中国帝国的附庸国。

implant.definition: n. a prosthesis placed permanently in tissue\nv. fix or set securely or deeply\nv. become attached to and embedded in the uterus
implant.translation: vt. 深植, 灌输, 嵌入\nn. 植入物, 植入管

examples.en: Decision to disallow Medicaid for second cochlea implant withdrawn.
A tooth can be replaced with an implant.
The cochlea implant is a technically ingenious device.

implement.definition: n. instrumentation (a piece of equipment or tool) used to effect an end\nv. apply in a manner consistent with its purpose or design
implement.translation: n. 工具, 器具, 手段\nvt. 实现, 使生效, 执行

examples.en: Our company will implement new price standards regarding this product.
examples.zh: 关于这个产品，我公司将执行新的价格标准。

examples.en: Lots of companies have implemented an eight-hour working day.
examples.zh: 很多公司实行8小时工作制。

examples.en: The company is starting to implement the new management system from next month.
examples.zh: 公司从下个月开始推行新的管理制度。

implication.definition: n. an accusation that brings into intimate and usually incriminating connection\nn. a logical relation between propositions p and q of the form `if p then q'; if p is true then q cannot be false\nn. a relation implicated by virtue of involvement or close connection (especially an incriminating involvement)
implication.translation: n. 牵连, 含义, 暗示\n[法] 推断, 含蓄之意, 暗示

examples.en: The implication was that where there was a well, there were residents.
examples.zh: 含义是哪里有水井，哪里就有居民。

examples.en: This will have enormous implications for Algeria.
examples.zh: 这将会对阿尔及利亚产生巨大的影响。

implicit.definition: a. implied though not directly expressed; inherent in the nature of something\ns. being without doubt or reserve
implicit.translation: a. 暗示的, 含蓄的, 固有的, 绝对的\n[经] 不讲明的, 含蓄的

examples.en: That's implicit. You don't need to state it explicitly.
We had an implicit agreement that we would support each other.
Some implicit elements can be made explicit.

imply.definition: v. express or state indirectly\nv. suggest as a logically necessary consequence; in logic\nv. have as a necessary feature
imply.translation: vt. 暗示, 意味\n[计] 隐含

examples.en: A good education doesn't imply a good upbringing.
examples.zh: 虽说是高学历，也未必就有教养。

examples.en: None of them could understand what she was implying.
examples.zh: 他们没有人了解她暗示什么。

examples.en: I didn't mean to imply that.
examples.zh: 我没想暗示那件事。

import.definition:
n. commodities (goods or services) bought from a foreign country
n. an imported person brought from a foreign country
v. bring in from abroad
v. transfer (electronic data) into a database or document
import.translation:
n. 进口货, 进口, 输入, 含义, 重要性
vt. 输入, 引入, 进口, 含...的意思, 重要
vi. 有关系
[计] 引入

examples.en: We're amazed by the rapid growth in import quantities.
examples.zh: 进口数量的急速增长让我们感到惊讶。

examples.en: He wanted to reduce the tax on imports.
examples.zh: 他想要减少进口品的税。

examples.en: Imported cars account for less than eight percent.
examples.zh: 进口车占了不到百分之八。

importance.definition: n. the quality of being important and worthy of note\nn. a prominent status
importance.translation: n. 重要, 重要性, 重要地位, 自大\n[机] 重要, 重要性

examples.en: This is considered to be a matter of great importance.
examples.zh: 这被认为是一件大事。

examples.en: Some day you will come to realize the importance of saving.
examples.zh: 你现在不好好储蓄金钱的话，终有一天会后悔的。

examples.en: This is a matter of the utmost importance.
examples.zh: 这件事至关重要。

important.definition: a. of great significance or value\ns. having or suggesting a consciousness of high position
important.translation: a. 重要的, 有地位的, 大量的, 显要的, 自负的\n[计] 要点

examples.en: It is very important for us to love a river.
examples.zh: 对于我们来说爱惜河川是很重要的。

examples.en: Most important of all a clock has to be accurate.
examples.zh: 一个时钟最重要的是准确。

examples.en: The important thing is to call the police at once.
examples.zh: 最重要的是马上报警。

impose.definition: v compel to behave in a certain way\nv impose something unpleasant\nv impose and collect
impose.translation: vt. 征(税), 把...强加于, 以...欺骗\nvi. 利用, 欺骗, 施加影响

examples.en: He always imposes his opinion on me.
examples.zh: 他总是把他的看法强加给我。

imposing.definition:
v compel to behave in a certain way
v impose something unpleasant
v impose and collect
s impressive in appearance
s used of a person's appearance or behavior; befitting an eminent person
imposing.translation: a. 令人难忘的, 壮丽的, 威风的

examples.en: We should try to avoid imposing our own beliefs on others.
examples.zh: 我们应该尽量避免把我们自己的信念强加在别人身上。

impossible.definition:
n. something that cannot be done
a. not capable of occurring or being accomplished or dealt with
s. totally unlikely
s. used of persons or their behavior
impossible.translation: a. 不可能的, 难以置信的, 令人无法忍受的

examples.en: It's next to impossible to finish it in a day.
examples.zh: 在一天之内完成它几乎是不可能的。

examples.en: It’s impossible to learn English in a short time.
examples.zh: 不可能短时间内学会英语。

examples.en: It is impossible to master English in a short time.
examples.zh: 不可能短时间内学会英语。

impress.definition:
n. the act of coercing someone into government service
v. impress positively
v. produce or try to produce a vivid impression of
v. mark or stamp with or as if with pressure
impress.translation: n. 印象, 特征, 印记\nvt. 使有印象, 印, 铭刻, 传送, 影响, 强征\nvi. 给人印象

examples.en: Wow, she’s got a lot of pace, I’m impressed!
examples.zh: 哇，她真是神速啊，真让我印象深刻！

examples.en: I couldn't help but be impressed by Tom's courage.
examples.zh: 汤姆的勇气给我留下了深刻印象。

examples.en: We were deeply impressed by the lecturer's eloquent speech.
examples.zh: 演讲者精彩的演说给我们留下了深刻的印象。

impression.definition:
n. a vague idea in which some confidence is placed
n. an outward appearance
n. all the copies of a work printed at one time
n. (dentistry) an imprint of the teeth and gums in wax or plaster
impression.translation: n. 印象, 意念, 盖印, 印记, 印数, 底色, 效果\n[医] 压迹, 印模, 印象, 影响

examples.en: What you said left a deep impression on me.
examples.zh: 你说的话给我留下了很深刻的印象。

examples.en: My first impression of him proved to be correct.
examples.zh: 我对他的第一印象果然没有错。

examples.en: You never get a second chance to make a first impression.
examples.zh: 你永远没有第二次机会去打造第一印象。

impressive.definition: a. making a strong or vivid impression\ns. producing a strong effect
impressive.translation: a. 给人深刻印象的, 威严的

examples.en: You've both been very impressive today. I'm proud of you.
examples.zh: 今天你们俩很让人印象深刻。我为你们感到骄傲。

examples.en: I find her very impressive.
examples.zh: 我对她有很深刻的印象。

imprison.definition: v. lock up or confine, in or as in a jail\nv. confine as if in a prison; he does not let them go out without a chaperone"
imprison.translation: vt. 使下狱, 关闭, 拘禁, 限制\n[法] 关押, 监禁, 限制

examples.en: Today, a nation ringed by walls would only imprison itself.
If they find out where Ziri is, they'll imprison him again.
The target of both armies is to imprison the opponent's king.

improve.definition: v to make better\nv get better
improve.translation: vt. 改良, 提高...的价值, 改善, 利用\nvi. 变得更好, 增加

examples.en: I'd like to find a way to improve my memory.
examples.zh: 我想找一种提升记忆力的方法。

examples.en: He made use of the opportunity to improve his English.
examples.zh: 他利用这个机会提高英语水平。

examples.en: The UK must improve the problems with its rail network.
examples.zh: 英国必须改善它在铁路网的问题。

improvement.definition: n. a change for the better; progress in development\nn. the act of improving something\nn. a condition superior to an earlier condition
improvement.translation: n. 进步, 改善, 利用\n[医] 改善, 好转, 进步

examples.en: Actually, the present method has plenty of room for improvement.
examples.zh: 其实现时的方法还有很大的改善空间。

examples.en: You must think of this as a great improvement.
examples.zh: 你应该认为这是个很可观的改进。

examples.en: Many improvements have been made since this century began.
examples.zh: 本世纪初以来，产生了很多进步。

impulse.definition: n. the act of applying force suddenly
impulse.translation: n. 冲动, 驱使, 刺激, 推动, 冲力, 建议, 脉冲\nvt. 推动

examples.en: He told his wife not to buy on impulse.
examples.zh: 他叫自己的妻子不要冲动购物。

examples.en: I felt an impulse to cry out loud.
examples.zh: 我突然好想大叫。

examples.en: Sharks are sensitive to electrical impulses as well as sound.
examples.zh: 鲨鱼对电子信号和噪音很敏感。

in.definition:
s. holding office
s. directed or bound inward
s. currently fashionable
r. to or toward the inside of
in.translation:
prep. 在...期间, 在...之内, 处于...之中, 从事于, 按照, 穿着
adv. 进入, 朝里, 在里面, 在屋里
a. 在里面的, 在朝的
n. 执政者, 交情

examples.en: I am going to fry an egg in a pan.
examples.zh: 我去用锅煎一个蛋。

examples.en: As a boy, I used to swim in the pond.
examples.zh: 我还是个小男孩时常去池塘游泳。

examples.en: Hope to see you next time I'm in N.Y.
examples.zh: 希望下次在纽约见到你。

inadequate.definition: a. lacking the requisite qualities or resources to meet a task\ns. not sufficient to meet a need
inadequate.translation: a. 不充分的, 不适当的\n[法] 不充分的, 不适当的

examples.en: He often compares himself to others and feels inadequate.
What percentage of illnesses are associated with inadequate diets?
Inadequate government support continues to damage many economic sectors in Morocco.

inaugurate.definition: v. commence officially\nv. open ceremoniously or dedicate formally\nv. be a precursor of
inaugurate.translation: vt. 开始, 举行...就职典礼

examples.en: The new community center was inaugurated yesterday with pomp and circumstance.
examples.zh: 新的社区中心在昨天隆重落成。

incense.definition: n. a substance that produces a fragrant odor when burned\nn. the pleasing scent produced when incense is burned
incense.translation: n. 香, 香气, 奉承\nvi. 焚香\nvt. 用香焚, 使发怒

examples.en: Ziri rubbed the doors and the windows with holy incense.
A lot of these old books smell of incense.
She likes to burn incense while practising yoga.
The cold winter wind wasn't really an incentive to cycling.
We lack an incentive for pursuing the eastern market.
The workers have no incentive to work harder.

incidence.definition: n. the relative frequency of occurrence of something\nn. the striking of a light beam on a surface
incidence.translation: n. 发生, 发生率, 影响, 负担者, 入射, 倾角\n[医] 入射, 发生率, 发生数

examples.en: Excuse me, sir, but is this an incidence of road rage?
The angle of incidence equals the angle of reflection.
The incidence of OCD is greatest among teens and young adults.

incident.definition: n. a single distinct event\nn. a public disturbance\na. falling or striking of light rays on something
incident.translation: n. 事件, 事变, 小事\na. 附带的, 易于发生的, 外来的, 入射的

examples.en: Russia expresses regret for those lost in the hostage incident.
examples.zh: 俄罗斯对在人质事件中牺牲的人们表示哀悼。

examples.en: The politician didn't appear in public after the incident.
examples.zh: 发生了那件事以后，那位政治家一直没有公开露面。

examples.en: I had nothing to do with that incident.
examples.zh: 我跟那个事件没有什么关系。

inclination.definition:
n. an attitude of mind especially one that favors one alternative over others
n. (astronomy) the angle between the plane of the orbit and the plane of the ecliptic stated in degrees
n. (geometry) the angle formed by the x-axis and a given line (measured counterclockwise from the positive half of the x-axis)
n. that toward which you are inclined to feel a liking
inclination.translation: n. 倾向, 趋向, 倾斜度, 点头\n[化] 倾角

examples.en: Chechens have inclinations towards independence.
examples.zh: 车臣人倾向独立。

incline.definition: v. bend or turn (one's ear) towards a speaker in order to listen well\nv. lower or bend (the head or upper body), as in a nod or bow\nv. feel favorably disposed or willing
incline.translation: n. 倾斜, 斜坡, 斜面\nvt. 使倾向于, 使倾斜\nvi. 倾向, 倾斜, 爱好, 易于

examples.en: Akin to someone driving a donkey up an incline.
Drivers hardly notice a gentle incline, but cyclists do.
Motorists hardly notice a gentle incline, but cyclists do.

include.definition: v. have as a part, be made up out of\nv. consider as part of something\nv. add as part of something else; put in as part of a set, group, or category
include.translation: vt. 包括, 把...算入, 包住\n[计] DOS内部命令:在CONFIG.SYS文件的一个配置块中包含另一配置块的内容

examples.en: Possible side effects include blurred vision and shortness of breath.
examples.zh: 可能会引起视力模糊、呼吸急促等副作用。

examples.en: Don't include multiple alternative words inside the same sentence.
examples.zh: 在同一句中不要包含多个可选单词。

examples.en: The price does not include the box.
examples.zh: 这个价格不包含这个箱子。

inclusive.definition: a. including much or everything; and especially including stated limits
inclusive.translation: a. 包含的, 包括的

examples.en: The price is ten dollars inclusive of the tax.
The atmosphere in that workplace is not very inclusive.
It is better to write out numbers up to ten, inclusive.

income.definition: n. the financial gain (earned or unearned) accruing over a given period of time
income.translation: n. 收入, 收益, 流入\n[经] 收益

examples.en: The majority of his income goes to pay his rent.
examples.zh: 他的大部分收入付了租金。

examples.en: His large income enables him to travel abroad every year.
examples.zh: 他的收入很高，所以每年都能出国旅行。

examples.en: I advise you never to live beyond your income.
examples.zh: 我建议你永远不要入不敷出。

incorporate.definition:
v. include or contain; have as a component
v. form a corporation
v. unite or merge with something already in existence
s. formed or united into a whole
incorporate.translation: a. 合并的, 组成公司的, 一体化的\nvt. 吸收, 合并, 使组成公司, 体现\nvi. 合并, 混合, 组成公司

examples.en: China is incorporating Algeria into its Belt and Road strategy.
examples.zh: 中国正将阿尔及利亚纳入「一带一路」战略。

examples.en: His teachings are incorporated in a profound book Daode Jing which Taoists regard as the final authority and doctrines of the religion.
examples.zh: 他的教导都包含在道教者看作关于宗教最后的权威的道德经那本深刻的书。

increase.definition:
n. a change resulting in an increase
n. a process of becoming larger or longer or more numerous or more important
n. the amount by which something increases
n. the act of increasing something
increase.translation: n. 增加, 增进, 利益\nvt. 增加, 加大\nvi. 增加, 繁殖

examples.en: This medicine will increase the survival rate of the patients.
examples.zh: 这个药品会提高病人的存活率。

examples.en: This company achieved a remarkable increase in turnover last year.
examples.zh: 这家公司去年获得显著的营业额增长。

examples.en: The number of traffic accidents seems to be on the increase.
examples.zh: 交通事故的数量似乎在增长。

increasingly.definition: r. advancing in amount or intensity
increasingly.translation: adv. 逐渐地, 渐增地

examples.en: In England, parks taking rare breeds of animals as their theme are becoming increasingly popular with people.
examples.zh: 在英国，以珍稀物种为主题的公园变得越来越受人们的欢迎。

examples.en: Over the past ten years, people have become increasingly aware that they need to change their eating habits.
examples.zh: 十年来，人们越来越强烈地意识到需要改变自己的饮食习惯。

examples.en: It's incredible that your mother speaks six languages!
examples.zh: 你母亲说六种语言真是让人难以置信！

examples.en: This matter is of incredible urgency!
examples.zh: 这件事十万火急！

examples.en: Friday evening was incredible.
examples.zh: 周五晚上真是太棒了。

incur.definition: v. make oneself subject to; bring upon oneself; become liable to
incur.translation: vt. 招致, 蒙受, 遭遇\n[经] 招致, 蒙受, 担负

examples.en: You do not want to incur the wrath of God.
If you are not careful, you will incur prohibitive expenses.
Delaying study incurs the risk of great effort with little success.

indeed.definition: r. in truth (often tends to intensify)\nr. (used as an interjection) an expression of surprise or skepticism or irony etc.
indeed.translation: adv. 的确, 实在, 真正地, 甚至

examples.en: A friend in need is a friend indeed.
examples.zh: 患难见真情。

examples.en: Indeed she is young and beautiful, but she is in delicate health.
examples.zh: 她确实年轻貌美，但她体质娇弱。

examples.en: Indeed, dwarf tossing is an Olympic sport!
examples.zh: 事实上，投掷侏儒是奥运会的运动项目。

independence.definition: n. freedom from control or influence of another or others\nn. the successful ending of the American Revolution\nn. a city in western Missouri; the beginning of the Santa Fe Trail
independence.translation: n. 独立, 自立, 自主\n[医] 自主性, 独立性

examples.en: The US declared independence from Great Britain in 1776.
examples.zh: 美利坚合众国于1776年宣布其独立于大不列颠王国。

examples.en: Lachin hosted concert marking May 28 – Independence Day.
examples.zh: 拉钦举办了一场音乐会，庆祝 5 月 28 日的独立纪念日。

examples.en: India gained independence from Britain in 1947.
examples.zh: 印度于1947年脱离英国获得独立。

independent.definition: a. free from external control and constraint\na. (of a clause) capable of standing syntactically alone as a complete sentence\ns. not controlled by a party or interest group
independent.translation: n. 独立自主者, 无党派者\na. 独立的, 有主见的, 不须依赖的, 不受约束的

examples.en: At that time, Mexico was not yet independent of Spain.
examples.zh: 那个时候，墨西哥还没有独立于西班牙。

examples.en: I advised him to be independent of his parents.
examples.zh: 我劝他别老想着啃老。

examples.en: In a democracy, it is important that the press be independent.
examples.zh: 在民主国家，报刊的独立是很重要的。

index.definition:
n. a numerical scale used to compare variables with one another or with some reference number
n. a number or ratio (a value on a scale of measurement) derived from a series of observed facts; can reveal relative changes as a function of time
n. an alphabetical listing of names and topics along with page numbers where they are discussed
n. the finger next to the thumb
index.translation:
n. 索引, 指针, 指数, 指标
vt. 编入索引中, 指出
vi. 做索引
[计] 下标; 附标; 变址; 索引; 编索引

examples.en: The application allows you to quickly calculate the ratio of body mass index - BMI.
examples.zh: 这项应用程序能让你快速计算身高体重指数（BMI）。

examples.en: We have optimized the database indexing, and as a result, system efficiency has improved by 50%.
examples.zh: 我们优化了数据库索引，结果系统效率提高了50%。

examples.en: The hand has five fingers: the thumb, the index finger, the middle finger, the ring finger, and the pinky.
examples.zh: 人的手有五个手指: 拇指、食指、中指、无名指和小指。

indicate.definition: v. indicate a place, direction, person, or thing; either spatially or figuratively\nv. to state or express briefly\nv. suggest the necessity of an intervention; in medicine
indicate.translation: vt. 显示, 象征, 指示, 指出\n[医] 指示

examples.en: I took his not coming to indicate that he wasn't interested.
examples.zh: 我将他的缺席视为没有兴趣。

examples.en: An increase in customer complaints may indicate that business is declining.
examples.zh: 顾客投诉量增加，可能代表生意正在走下坡。

examples.en: The contents of the box are indicated on the label.
examples.zh: 箱子的内容在标签上面写着。

indication.definition:
n. something that serves to indicate or suggest
n. the act of indicating or pointing out by name
n. (medicine) a reason to prescribe a drug or perform a procedure
n. something (as a course of action) that is indicated as expedient or necessary
indication.translation: n. 指示, 象征, 暗示\n[医] 指示, 指征, 适应征

examples.en: His victory at this age in an international competition is a good indication of a bright future.
examples.zh: 他现在这个年纪，就已经在国际比赛中取胜，前途实在无可限量。

indicator.definition: n. a signal for attracting attention\nn. a device for showing the operating condition of some system\nn. (chemistry) a substance that changes color to indicate the presence of some ion or substance; can be used to indicate the completion of a chemical reaction or (in medicine) to test for a particular reaction
indicator.translation: n. 指示器, 指示剂, 指标\n[计] 指示器

examples.en: Frogs are an indicator of the health of the forest.
Didn't anyone teach you how to use an indicator?
Self-harm is often regarded as an indicator of insanity.

indifferent.definition:
s. showing no care or concern in attitude or action
s. fairly poor to not very good
s. marked by no especial liking or dislike or preference for one thing over another
s. characterized by a lack of partiality
indifferent.translation: a. 漠不关心的, 无重要性的, 中立的\n[医] 中性的, 无作用的, 无亲和力的, 淡漠的

examples.en: How can you be so indifferent to your wife's trouble?
examples.zh: 你妻子遇上麻烦，你怎么还一副事不关己，己不劳心的样子？

examples.en: Lots of people in Japan are indifferent to politics.
examples.zh: 很多日本人对政治冷淡。

examples.en: You are too indifferent to those around you.
examples.zh: 你对待身边的人太冷漠了。

indigenous.definition: s originating where it is found
indigenous.translation: a. 本土的, 国产的, 固有的\n[医] 原产的, 本土的

examples.en: Indigenous Australians have eaten kangaroos for millennia.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚土著已经吃了上千年袋鼠。

examples.en: This plant is indigenous to Canada.
examples.zh: 这种植物原产于加拿大。

examples.en: Pachamama is a goddess of earth and fertility revered by the indigenous peoples of the Andes.
examples.zh: 帕查玛玛是安地斯山脉土著居民敬仰的大地和生育女神。

indignant.definition: s. angered at something unjust or wrong
indignant.translation: a. 愤怒的, 愤慨的

examples.en: She was indignant at the way she had been treated.
I would be indignant (whenever people spoke hardly of me).
I am indignant about the way he treated me.

indignation.definition: n. a feeling of righteous anger
indignation.translation: n. 愤怒, 愤慨, 义愤

examples.en: Tears again welled up in his eyes, tears of indignation!
All the strikers came out of the building in indignation.
Many Greeks feel great indignation when Germans give them advice.

indirect.definition:
s. having intervening factors or persons or influences
a. not direct in spatial dimension; not leading by a straight line or course to a destination
a. extended senses; not direct in manner or language or behavior or action
s. not as a direct effect or consequence
indirect.translation: a. 间接的, 非直截了当的, 不坦率的\n[医] 间接的

examples.en: Persecution is a bad and indirect way to plant Religion.
In Arcaicam Esperantom, the ending -d marks an indirect object.
You need to complete the exercise using indirect speech.

indispensable.definition: a. not to be dispensed with; essential\ns. unavoidable
indispensable.translation: n. 不可缺少之物\na. 不可缺少的, 责无旁贷的, 绝对必要的

examples.en: Your help is indispensable for the success of the scheme.
examples.zh: 没有你帮忙，计划就不能成功了。

examples.en: Both air and water are indispensable for life.
examples.zh: 没有空气和水，人类就无法生存。

examples.en: In places where it snows a lot, kerosene is an indispensable item.
examples.zh: 在下雪很多的地方，煤油是不可或缺的东西。

individual.definition:
n. a single organism
a. being or characteristic of a single thing or person
s. separate and distinct from others of the same kind
s. characteristic of or meant for a single person or thing
individual.translation: n. 人, 个人, 个体\na. 个别的, 个人的, 独特的

examples.en: She had an individual style of speaking.
examples.zh: 她说话有自己的风格。

examples.en: Individual freedom is the soul of democracy.
examples.zh: 个人自由是民主的精髓。

examples.en: For many individuals, the pentatonic scale is associated with Chinese music.
examples.zh: 在很多人的印象中，五声音阶往往与中国音乐挂钩。

induce.definition:
v. cause to arise
v. cause to do; cause to act in a specified manner
v. cause to occur rapidly
v. reason or establish by induction
induce.translation: vt. 引诱, 招致, 归纳出, 感应\n[医] 诱导, 感应

examples.en: Nothing could induce him to change his mind.
Moderate exercise in the evening helps induce sleep.
What can have induced him to behave so cruelly?

indulge.definition: v. give free rein to\nv. enjoy to excess
indulge.translation: vt. 纵情于, 使高兴, 放任, 迁就\nvi. 沉溺

examples.en: Santiago made Rima promise never to indulge in drinking again.
This is not the time to indulge in memories.
Today I can indulge myself in a few luxuries.

industrial.definition:
a. of or relating to or resulting from industry
a. having highly developed industries
s. employed in industry
s. suitable to stand up to hard wear
industrial.translation: a. 工业的, 供工业用的, 工业高度发展的, 产业的\nn. 工业工人, 工业股票

examples.en: It occurred to me that he might be an industrial spy.
examples.zh: 我突然想到他可能是个商业间谍。

examples.en: In China's agricultural and industrial areas, some people are still very poor.
examples.zh: 在中国乡村和工业区，有的人还是很穷的。

examples.en: Many people work in industrial towns.
examples.zh: 许多人在工业城市工作。

industry.definition: n. the people or companies engaged in a particular kind of commercial enterprise\nn. the organized action of making of goods and services for sale
industry.translation: n. 勤劳, 工业, 企业, 产业, 有组织的劳动\n[经] 工业, 实业

examples.en: The development of the computer industry has been very rapid.
examples.zh: 电脑产业的发展一日千里。

examples.en: Japan is a leader in the world's high-tech industry.
examples.zh: 日本是世界高科技产业的领头人。

examples.en: Japan is the leader of the world's high-tech industry.
examples.zh: 日本是世界高科技产业的领头人。

inequality.translation: n. 不平等, 不同, 不平坦, 不平均\nn. 不平等, 不等式\n[计] 不等式

examples.en: Algeria needs to iron out inequality between men and women.
In this paper, the authors examine health, wealth and inequality.
During the presentation the speaker talked mainly about gender inequality.

inevitable.definition: n. an unavoidable event\na. incapable of being avoided or prevented\ns. invariably occurring or appearing
inevitable.translation: a. 不可避免的, 必然的\n[法] 不可避免的, 无法规避的, 必然的

examples.en: Being challenged in life is inevitable, being defeated is optional.
examples.zh: 生命中你无法选择接踵而至的挑战，但是你可以选择不成为一个失败者。

examples.en: The Foreign Minister said that war was inevitable.
examples.zh: 外交部长称战争在所难免。

examples.en: The troubles of life are inevitable.
examples.zh: 生活中的烦恼在所难免。

infant.definition: n a very young child (birth to 1 year) who has not yet begun to walk or talk
infant.translation: n. 婴儿, 儿童, 初学者\na. 婴儿的, 幼稚的

examples.en: The young woman was carrying an infant in her arms.
examples.zh: 那个年轻女人手抱著婴儿。

examples.en: You should really take an infant CPR class.
examples.zh: 你应该去上婴儿心肺复苏课程。

examples.en: It can make some people, especially the elderly and infants, very ill.
examples.zh: 它可以使一些人，尤其是老人和婴幼儿，病得很重。

infect.definition:
v. communicate a disease to
v. contaminate with a disease or microorganism
v. corrupt with ideas or an ideology
v. affect in a contagious way
infect.translation: vt. 传染, 感染\n[医] 传染, 感染

examples.en: My computer has already been infected with the BraveSentry virus.
examples.zh: 我的电脑已经中了BraveSentry病毒。

examples.en: My computer has been infected with BraveSentry.
examples.zh: 我的电脑已经中了BraveSentry病毒。

examples.en: He got infected with HIV.
examples.zh: 他感染了爱滋病。

infection.definition:
n. the pathological state resulting from the invasion of the body by pathogenic microorganisms
n. (phonetics) the alteration of a speech sound under the influence of a neighboring sound
n. (medicine) the invasion of the body by pathogenic microorganisms and their multiplication which can lead to tissue damage and disease
n. an incident in which an infectious disease is transmitted
infection.translation: n. 传染, 影响, 传染病\n[医] 传染, 感染

examples.en: He had an infection in his belly button.
examples.zh: 他的肚脐发炎了。

infer.definition:
v reason by deduction; establish by deduction
v draw from specific cases for more general cases
v conclude by reasoning; in logic
v guess correctly; solve by guessing
v believe to be the case
infer.translation: vt. 推论出, 推断\nvi. 作推论

examples.en: What do you infer from her strange behavior?
What can you infer from Tom's conduct?
What can you infer from these observations?

inferior.definition:
n. one of lesser rank or station or quality
a. of or characteristic of low rank or importance
a. of low or inferior quality
a. having an orbit between the sun and the Earth's orbit
inferior.translation: a. 次等的, 较差的, 下方的, 下级的\nn. 部下, 次品, 下标(符号)

examples.en: There is no reason for you to feel inferior to anyone.
examples.zh: 你没理由觉得自己比别人差的。

examples.en: He is inferior to you in all respects.
examples.zh: 他在各方面都比不上你。

examples.en: She is inferior to him in math.
examples.zh: 她在数学上不如他。

infinite.definition: a. having no limits or boundaries in time or space or extent or magnitude\na. of verbs; having neither person nor number nor mood (as a participle or gerund or infinitive)\ns. total and all-embracing
infinite.translation: n. 无限, 神\na. 无穷的, 无限的, 极大的

examples.en: The eternal silence of these infinite spaces terrifies me.
examples.zh: 这些无限空间的永恒沉默使我恐惧。

examples.en: There's no doubt that the universe is infinite.
examples.zh: 宇宙毫无疑问是无限的。

examples.en: There's no doubt: the universe is infinite.
examples.zh: 宇宙毫无疑问是无限的。

inflation.definition: n. a general and progressive increase in prices\nn. (cosmology) a brief exponential expansion of the universe (faster than the speed of light) postulated to have occurred shortly after the big bang\nn. the act of filling something with air
inflation.translation: n. 胀大, 夸张, 通货膨胀\n[化] 充气吹胀; 膨胀

examples.en: The value of the dollar declines as the rate of inflation rises.
examples.zh: 随着通货膨胀的发展美元贬值了。

examples.en: Interest rates and inflation were high.
examples.zh: 利率和通货膨胀很高。

influence.definition:
n. a power to affect persons or events especially power based on prestige etc
n. causing something without any direct or apparent effort
n. a cognitive factor that tends to have an effect on what you do
n. the effect of one thing (or person) on another
influence.translation: n. 影响力, 权力, 势力\nvt. 影响, 改变

examples.en: Many TV programs have a bad influence on children.
examples.zh: 许多电视节目对儿童有不良的影响。

examples.en: He has a strong influence over the business world.
examples.zh: 他在商界有很大的影响力。

examples.en: Do you think our climate has an influence on our character?
examples.zh: 你觉得气候会不会影响人的性格呢？

influential.definition: a. having or exercising influence or power
influential.translation: a. 有影响的, 有势力的

examples.en: He is very influential in the world of medicine.
examples.zh: 他在医学界有很大的影响力。

examples.en: He's very influential in the world of medicine.
examples.zh: 他在医学界有很大的影响力。

examples.en: Rousseau was mad but influential; Hume was sane but had no followers.
examples.zh: 卢梭是疯狂的, 但有影响力; 休谟是理智的, 但没有追随者。

inform.definition: v. impart knowledge of some fact, state or affairs, or event to\nv. give character or essence to\nv. act as an informer
inform.translation: vt. 通知, 使了解, 使充满\nvi. 提供资料, 告发

examples.en: Please inform me of the plan ahead of time.
examples.zh: 请你事先把计划告诉我。

examples.en: Please inform me of any changes in the situation.
examples.zh: 如果情况有任何变化，请务必通知我。

examples.en: Ziri and Rima didn’t even call the school to inform them.
examples.zh: 齐里和里玛甚至没有打电话通知学校。

information.definition:
n. a message received and understood
n. knowledge acquired through study or experience or instruction
n. formal accusation of a crime
n. (communication theory) a numerical measure of the uncertainty of an outcome
information.translation: n. 消息, 知识, 通知, 情报, 信息, 问讯处, 起诉\n[计] 信息

examples.en: The information you gave me is of little use.
examples.zh: 你给我的资料没有多大的用处。

examples.en: Do you have any information on classical music concerts?
examples.zh: 你对古典音乐会有什么可说的吗？

examples.en: We may combine your personal information with other information.
examples.zh: 我们可能会将你的私人信息和其他信息结合在一起。

infrastructure.definition: n. the basic structure or features of a system or organization\nn. the stock of basic facilities and capital equipment needed for the functioning of a country or area
infrastructure.translation: n. 基础结构, 基础设施\n[经] 基础设施

examples.en: The infrastructure of an application is directly related to its overall performance.
examples.zh: 一个应用的架构直接关系到它的整体性能。

infringe.definition: v go against, as of rules and laws\nv advance beyond the usual limit
infringe.translation: v. 破坏, 侵犯, 违反

examples.en: The jury found that Samsung had infringed upon Apple's patents.
Piper filed a bill to enjoin Brown from infringing two patents.
They infringe on our basic freedoms.

ingenious.translation: a. 灵敏的, 精巧的, 聪明的

examples.en: Everyone's tricks are different; each differs in ingenious ways.
examples.zh: 戏法人人会变，各有巧妙不同。

ingredient.definition: n. a component of a mixture or compound\nn. food that is a component of a mixture in cooking
ingredient.translation: n. 成分, 因素\n[化] 配合剂; 拼料; 成分; 组分

examples.en: He added another ingredient to the pot.
examples.zh: 他又往锅里加了一种食材。

examples.en: Peas and carrots are common ingredients in soups.
examples.zh: 豌豆和胡萝卜是做汤的常见配料。

examples.en: Cookies may contain nuts or peanuts, even if not included in the ingredient list.
examples.zh: 虽然配料表中未列出坚果和花生，但饼干中仍可能含有这些成分。。

inhabit.translation: vt. 居住于, 占据, 栖息

examples.en: It's fertile land inhabited by diverse nations.
examples.zh: 这是一片肥沃的土地，居住著不同的民族。

examples.en: Alert, in Nunavut, Canada, is the northernmost permanently inhabited place in the world.
examples.zh: 加拿大努纳武特地区的阿勒特是世界上最北端的永久居住地。

inherent.definition: s existing as an essential constituent or characteristic\ns in the nature of something though not readily apparent
inherent.translation: a. 固有的, 与生俱来的\n[医] 固有的, 生来的

examples.en: We must never forget the inherent value of every human being.
examples.zh: 我们一定不能忘记每个人的内在价值。

examples.en: She has inherent dignity.
examples.zh: 她有与生俱来的尊严。

examples.en: The Chinese government issued a white paper entitled "Diaoyu Islands are China's inherent territory" on the 25th.
examples.zh: 25日，中国政府发布《钓鱼岛是中国的固有领土》白皮书。

inherit.definition: v. obtain from someone after their death\nv. receive from a predecessor\nv. receive by genetic transmission
inherit.translation: vt. 继承, 遗传\nvi. 接受遗产

examples.en: What did Tom inherit?
examples.zh: 汤姆继承了什么？

examples.en: John inherited a large fortune.
examples.zh: John 继承了一大笔财产。

examples.en: Anna's striking almond-shaped eyes, inherited from her Asian lineage, exude a captivating depth and a hint of mystery.
examples.zh: 安娜引人注目的杏仁状眼睛继承了她的亚洲血统，散发著迷人的深度和一丝神秘感。

inhibit.definition: v. limit the range or extent of\nv. limit, block, or decrease the action or function of\nv. control and refrain from showing; of emotions, desires, impulses, or behavior
inhibit.translation: vt. 禁止, 抑制\nvi. 起抑制作用

examples.en: He noticed that this drug seemed to inhibit bacterial growth.
I should act, yet fear inhibits me from doing so.
The passive-aggressive behavior of the English teacher inhibits effective communication.

initial.definition: n. the first letter of a word (especially a person's name)\nv. mark with one's initials\ns. occurring at the beginning
initial.translation: n. 字首, 首字母\na. 开始的, 最初的, 字首的\nvt. 用姓名的首字母签名

examples.en: Your initial order is subject to a special discount of 5%.
examples.zh: 首次订购可获九五折的特别优惠。

examples.en: What do the initials NTT stand for?
examples.zh: NTT这个缩写是什么意思？

initiate.definition:
n. someone who has been admitted to membership in a scholarly field
n. people who have been introduced to the mysteries of some field or activity
v. take the lead or initiative in; participate in the development of
v. accept people into an exclusive society or group, usually with some rite
initiate.translation: n. 入会, 开始\na. 新加入的\nvt. 开始, 传授基本知识给

examples.en: "I'll do my best" often means "I won't initiate anything".
Politicians initiate wars, not ordinary people who suffer from them.
The prime minister can initiate a vote of confidence.

initiative.definition: n readiness to embark on bold new ventures\nn the first of a series of actions\ns serving to set in motion
initiative.translation: n. 主动行动, 首创精神, 主动权\na. 自发的, 起始的

examples.en: The initiative measurably improved quality of life for the villagers.
examples.zh: 计划使村民的生活改善了不少。

examples.en: Local businesses are teaming up for a charity initiative.
examples.zh: 当地企业正在联手举办一项慈善活动。

examples.en: He takes the initiative in helping his mother do the housework.
examples.zh: 他主动帮他妈妈做家务。

inject.definition:
v. give an injection to
v. to introduce (a new aspect or element)
v. force or drive (a fluid or gas) into by piercing
v. take by injection
inject.translation: vt. 注射, 注入, 使入轨\n[医] 注射

examples.en: Maybe you can inject some bleach into your arm.
Damiano planned to inject the alien with the drug.
Damiano managed to inject the serum into the alien.

injection.definition: n. the forceful insertion of a substance under pressure\nn. any solution that is injected (as into the skin)\nn. the act of putting a liquid into the body by means of a syringe
injection.translation: n. 注射, 注射剂\n[化] 注入; 注射

examples.en: It's alright. This injection won't hurt. It will just prick a little.
examples.zh: 没关系的，这个针不痛的，就只有一点点刺痛感。

examples.en: I need to give you an injection.
examples.zh: 我得给你打一针。

examples.en: The nurse gave me a glucose injection.
examples.zh: 护士给我打了葡萄糖。

injury.definition:
n. any physical damage to the body caused by violence or accident or fracture etc.
n. an accident that results in physical damage or hurt
n. an act that causes someone or something to receive physical damage
n. wrongdoing that violates another's rights and is unjustly inflicted
injury.translation: n. 伤害, 侮辱\n[医] 伤, 损伤

examples.en: How did you get this injury on your foot?
examples.zh: 脚上的伤是怎么回事？

examples.en: Where did that injury on your foot come from?
examples.zh: 脚上的伤是怎么回事？

examples.en: I got hurt during an experiment, and the injury was pretty serious.
examples.zh: 我做实验的时候弄伤了，而且还伤得十分严重。

inland.definition: a. situated away from an area's coast or border\nr. towards or into the interior of a region
inland.translation: a. 内陆的, 国内的\nn. 内地

examples.en: Chinese coastal cities are generally more developed than the inland ones.
examples.zh: 中国大陆的沿海城市普遍比内陆城市发达。

inn.definition: n a hotel providing overnight lodging for travelers
inn.translation: n. 旅馆, 客栈\nvi. 住旅馆

examples.en: A fire broke out at the inn where they were staying.
examples.zh: 火警发生在他们住的旅馆。

inner.definition:
s. located inward
a. located or occurring within or closer to a center
s. innermost or essential
s. exclusive to a center; especially a center of influence
inner.translation: a. 内部的, 内心的\nn. 内部

examples.en: His encounter with her is enriching his inner life.
examples.zh: 与她的相遇丰富了他的精神生活。

examples.en: Politicians never tell us their inner thoughts.
examples.zh: 政治家从来不告诉我们他们的别有用心。

examples.en: Music is inner life, and he will never suffer loneliness who has inner life.
examples.zh: 音乐是内心世界，拥有了内心世界的他永远不会觉得孤独。

innocence.definition: n. a state or condition of being innocent of a specific crime or offense
innocence.translation: n. 无罪, 无知, 天真无邪\n[法] 无罪, 无罪的人, 清白无辜者

examples.en: I have a firm belief in his innocence.
examples.zh: 我坚信他是无辜的。

examples.en: There is no doubt as to her innocence.
examples.zh: 她毫无疑问是清白的。

examples.en: He put on an air of innocence.
examples.zh: 他摆出一副无辜的样子。

innocent.definition:
n. a person who lacks knowledge of evil
a. free from evil or guilt
s. lacking intent or capacity to injure
s. lacking in sophistication or worldliness
innocent.translation: a. 无罪的, 不懂事的, 无知的\nn. 天真的人, 笨蛋

examples.en: The court declared him innocent on the charge of murder.
examples.zh: 法庭对他的谋杀罪名作出了无罪判决。

examples.en: If he is innocent, then his wife is guilty.
examples.zh: 如果他是清白的，那他妻子就有罪。

examples.en: Yanni took the life of an innocent young man.
examples.zh: Yanni 夺走了一个无辜年轻人的生命。

innovation.definition: n a creation (a new device or process) resulting from study and experimentation\nn the creation of something in the mind\nn the act of starting something for the first time; introducing something new
innovation.translation: n. 改革, 创新\n[法] 创新, 改革, 刷新

examples.en: The company's success is built on a bedrock of innovation.
Mary is the dynamo behind the company's most recent innovation.
Innovation makes the difference between who leads and who obeys.

innovative.definition: s. being or producing something like nothing done or experienced or created before
innovative.translation: a. 革新的, 创新的, 富有革新精神的

examples.en: This is an innovative solution.
examples.zh: 这是个创新的解法。

input.definition: n. a component of production; something that goes into the production of output\nv. enter (data or a program) into a computer
input.translation: n. 输入, 输入电路\nvt. 输入\n[计] 输入

examples.en: The input method also works with this version.
examples.zh: 此输入法也适用于这个版本。

inquire.definition: v inquire about\nv have a wish or desire to know something\nv conduct an inquiry or investigation of
inquire.translation: v. 询问, 问明, 查究

examples.en: The committee inquired into the cause of the accident.
examples.zh: 委员会调查了事故的原因。

examples.en: When I met my former teacher, he inquired after my parents.
examples.zh: 我遇见了以前的班主任时，他问候了我的父母。

examples.en: She had the courage to go and inquire about the results of the exam.
examples.zh: 她有勇气去查询考试的结果。

inquiry.definition: n. a search for knowledge\nn. a systematic investigation of a matter of public interest
inquiry.translation: n. 质询, 探索, 调查, 询盘\n[计] 询问; 查询

examples.en: For media inquiries, please contact your local communications or marketing representative.
examples.zh: 如需媒体联络，请与当地客服中心或行销团队联系。

examples.en: We made inquiries into his past.
examples.zh: 我们对他的过去进行了调查。

insane.definition: a. afflicted with or characteristic of mental derangement
insane.translation: a. 患精神病的, 极愚蠢的\n[医] 神经错乱的

examples.en: Chih-ming’s insane — he always wins the last round in mahjong.
examples.zh: 志明真的很扯，每次打麻将都胡最后一把。

examples.en: He behaves as if he were insane.
examples.zh: 他表现得像疯了一样。

examples.en: This world is just an insane asylum.
examples.zh: 世界就是一个疯子的囚笼。

inscription.definition: n. letters inscribed (especially words engraved or carved) on something\nn. the activity of inscribing (especially carving or engraving) letters or words
inscription.translation: n. 题字, 碑铭\n[医] 划, 药量记载

examples.en: A touching inscription was etched into the tombstone.
The facsimile proved that the inscription was genuine.
These inscriptions date back to the tenth century before Christ.

insect.translation: n. 昆虫, 卑鄙的人\n[医] 昆虫

examples.en: The insect grew out of a pupa into an imago.
examples.zh: 昆虫破蛹而出变成成虫。

examples.en: What do you call this insect in English?
examples.zh: 这种昆虫在英语中叫什么？

examples.en: Have you been bitten by an insect?
examples.zh: 你被虫咬了吗？

insert.definition:
n. a folded section placed between the leaves of another publication
n. an artifact that is inserted or is to be inserted
v. put or introduce into something
v. introduce
insert.translation:
n. 插入物
vt. 插入, 把(人造卫星)射入(轨道), 添写
vi. 附着
[计] 插入

examples.en: This is an automated payphone; you use it by inserting a coin.
examples.zh: 这是自动投币电话，用一元硬币来打的。

examples.en: Having forgotten his key, he was able to open the door by inserting a wire in the keyhole.
examples.zh: 他没带钥匙，用铁丝拨动了两下，门居然开了。

inside.definition:
n. the region that is inside of something
n. the inner or enclosed surface of something
a. relating to or being on the side closer to the center or within a defined space
s. being or applying to the inside of a building
inside.translation:
n. 内部, 内脏, 内幕
a. 内部的, 秘密的, 户内的
adv. 在里面
prep. 在...之内

examples.en: I found a taxi, but there was no driver inside.
examples.zh: 我找到了一辆出租车，但里面却没有司机。

examples.en: He took out the wallet from his inside jacket pocket.
examples.zh: 他从他外套内袋里拿出皮夹。

examples.en: Iron the inside of collars first, and then the outside.
examples.zh: 先熨烫领子的里面，然后是外面。

insight.definition: n. a feeling of understanding\nn. the clear (and often sudden) understanding of a complex situation\nn. grasping the inner nature of things intuitively
insight.translation: n. 察看, 洞察力, 见识\n[医] 自知力, 洞察, 顿悟

examples.en: The myth offers insights into the ancient civilization.
examples.zh: 神话让我们能透悉古文明。

insist.definition: v. be emphatic or resolute and refuse to budge\nv. assert to be true
insist.translation: v. 坚持, 坚决主张, 强调

examples.en: They will insist on her staying there longer.
examples.zh: 他们会坚持要她逗留久一点。

examples.en: The doctor insisted that the patient get plenty of rest.
examples.zh: 医生坚持病人获得充分的休息。

examples.en: They insist that daily exercise is an action that must be done.
examples.zh: 他们坚持认为日常锻练是必得表出的行为。

inspect.translation: vt. 检查, 检阅, 检验\nvi. 检查

examples.en: "I need to inspect the wound," said the doctor.
examples.zh: “我必须检查下伤口，”医生说道。

examples.en: Sir, can we quickly inspect your luggage please?
examples.zh: 先生，我们可以检查一下您的行李吗？

examples.en: Everything has been suspected and been inspected; thoughts have no boundaries.
examples.zh: 所有的事物都要被怀疑、被验证，思想没有界限。

inspection.definition: n. a formal or official examination
inspection.translation: n. 检验, 检查, 视察\n[医] 检查, 视察, 监督, 望诊

examples.en: Korea allowed an inspection by the IAEA.
examples.zh: 韩国允许了国际原子能总署的视察。

inspiration.definition: n. arousal of the mind to special unusual activity or creativity\nn. a product of your creative thinking and work\nn. a sudden intuition as part of solving a problem
inspiration.translation: n. 灵感, 鼓舞人心的人或物, 妙计, 吸气\n[医] 吸[气]

examples.en: My mother was an angel and an inspiration to me.
examples.zh: 我的母亲是一位天使，也是我的灵感来源。

examples.en: After climbing Mt Fuji I got the inspiration for a poem.
examples.zh: 攀登富士山后，我得到了一首诗的灵感。

examples.en: After climbing Mt. Fuji, I got the inspiration for a poem.
examples.zh: 攀登富士山后，我得到了一首诗的灵感。

inspire.definition: v. heighten or intensify\nv. supply the inspiration for
inspire.translation: vt. 使感动, 激发, 启示, 吸入, 鼓舞, 产生, 使生灵感\nvi. 吸入, 赋予灵感

examples.en: I inspired my students to work harder.
examples.zh: 我鼓励学生们更努力地学习。

examples.en: She's a strange, enigmatic and inspiring poet.
examples.zh: 她是一个奇怪，神秘和鼓舞人心的诗人。

examples.en: His speech inspired all the boys.
examples.zh: 他的演说激励了所有的男孩。

install.definition: v. set up for use\nv. put into an office or a position\nv. place
install.translation: vt. 安装, 安置, 使就职\n[计] 安装, 安装程序; DOS内部命令:安装常驻程序

examples.en: The man tried to install his own antenna.
examples.zh: 这男人试着安装他自己的天线。

examples.en: I want to have a telephone installed.
examples.zh: 我想安装一台电话。

examples.en: They installed a vending machine at work.
examples.zh: 他们在办公室安装了一台自动贩卖机。

installation.definition: n. the act of installing something (as equipment)
installation.translation: n. 安装, 装置, 就职\n[医] 结构, 装置, 设立

examples.en: Is this community safe? Are there lighting installations for the night?
examples.zh: 小区安全吗？夜晚有照明设施吗？

instance.definition: n an occurrence of something\nn an item of information that is typical of a class or group\nv clarify by giving an example of
instance.translation: n. 建议, 情况, 例子, 场合\nvt. 引以为例, 举例说明

examples.en: You can't access an instance variable from a static method.
For instance, gauges, such as thermometers and barometers, are instruments.
For instance, bowing is peculiar to us, the Japanese.

instant.definition: s. in or of the present month
instant.translation: n. 立即, 瞬间\na. 紧急的, 立即的, 即时的

examples.en: I had instant noodles as a midnight snack.
examples.zh: 我消夜吃了速食面。

examples.en: If you drink instant coffee you do not need a coffee pot.
examples.zh: 如果你喝速溶咖啡，就不需要咖啡壶了。

examples.en: Right at that instant, the bus stopped.
examples.zh: 就在那时，公交车停住了。

instead.definition: r in place of, or as an alternative to\nr on the contrary; rather (or instead), he wrote her a letter"
instead.translation: adv. 作为替代, 反而

examples.en: I might give up soon and have a kip instead.
examples.zh: 也许我会马上放弃然后去打盹。

examples.en: I stayed home all day instead of going to work.
examples.zh: 我没有去工作，在家里待了一整天。

examples.en: The candle went out instead of having been put out.
examples.zh: 蜡烛是自己熄灭的，而不是被扑灭的。

instinct.definition: n. inborn pattern of behavior often responsive to specific stimuli\ns. (followed by `with')deeply filled or permeated
instinct.translation: n. 本能, 直觉\na. 充满着的

examples.en: Most animals have an instinct to protect their young.
examples.zh: 大多数动物都有保护幼仔的本能。

examples.en: Animals act on instinct.
examples.zh: 动物依靠牠们的本能行动。

examples.en: To be a good batter, you've got to hang loose and follow your instincts.
examples.zh: 想成为一个好的击球手的话，你要在球场上时刻保持镇定，还要学会相信自己的直觉。

institute.definition: n. an association organized to promote art or science or education\nv. advance or set forth in court
institute.translation: n. 学会, 学院, 协会\nvt. 创立, 开始, 制定, 任命

examples.en: A new classroom building was built in our institute last year.
examples.zh: 去年我们学院建了一个新教学楼。

examples.en: At The Happiness Institute in Australia, a couple of hundred dollars may do the trick.
examples.zh: 在澳大利亚的快乐协会，两百块钱可能达到效果。

institution.definition: n. an organization founded and united for a specific purpose\nn. an establishment consisting of a building or complex of buildings where an organization for the promotion of some cause is situated\nn. a custom that for a long time has been an important feature of some group or society
institution.translation: n. 机构, 惯例, 制度\n[医] 机关, 机构, 设施

examples.en: The institution of marriage appears to be on the decline.
They represent not only themselves but this institution as well.
Sami was in an institution for the mentally ill.

institutional.definition: a. relating to or constituting or involving an institution\na. organized as or forming an institution
institutional.translation: a. 制度的, 公共机构的, 学会的\n[法] 组织机构的, 制度的, 公共机构的

examples.en: Institutional change is essential to eradicate racism and dehumanization.
Institutional oppression is hard to see when you aren't affected by it.
Institutional racism is a serious problem.

instruct.definition: v. give instructions or directions for some task\nv. make aware of
instruct.translation: vt. 教, 教育, 命令, 通知\n[法] 托办, 指导, 指示

examples.en: Please do as they have instructed you.
examples.zh: 请按他们教你的做。

instruction.definition: n. (computer science) a line of code written as part of a computer program
instruction.translation: n. 指令, 教导, 命令\n[计] 指令

examples.en: I'll keep the instructions you sent for assembling the furniture.
examples.zh: 我会将你传来的家具组装说明记下来。

examples.en: From reading good books we can derive pleasure, friendship, experience and instruction.
examples.zh: 读书，可以获得乐趣、友谊、经验和指导。

examples.en: He gave me precise instructions to do the job.
examples.zh: 他给我的工作作出了明确指示。

instructor.definition: n a person whose occupation is teaching
instructor.translation: n. 教员, 讲师\n[法] 指导者, 教员, 讲师

examples.en: I know an English language instructor who comes from Canada.
examples.zh: 我认识一个加拿大来的英语教师。

examples.en: My driving instructor says I should be more patient.
examples.zh: 我的驾驶导师说我应该耐心一点。

instrument.definition:
n. a device that requires skill for proper use
n. the means whereby some act is accomplished
n. a person used by another to gain an end
v. equip with instruments for measuring, recording, or controlling
instrument.translation: n. 工具, 手段, 仪器\n[化] 仪器

examples.en: Do you play any instrument other than the piano?
examples.zh: 除了钢琴以外，还会玩什么乐器吗？

examples.en: My favourite musical instrument is the electric guitar.
examples.zh: 我最喜欢的乐器是电吉他。

examples.en: Do you play any instruments other than the piano?
examples.zh: 除了钢琴以外，还会玩什么乐器吗？

instrumental.definition: a. relating to or designed for or performed on musical instruments
instrumental.translation: a. 仪器的, 器具的, 可作为手段的\n[医] 器械的

examples.en: I like instrumental music.
examples.zh: 我喜欢器乐。

insufficient.definition: a. of a quantity not able to fulfill a need or requirement
insufficient.translation: a. 不够的, 不能胜任的, 不充足的\n[法] 不足的, 不充分的, 不能胜任的

examples.en: Don't read under insufficient light, for it is bad for your eyes.
examples.zh: 不要在太暗的光线下看书，那对你的眼睛不好的。

examples.en: There is insufficient light to take pictures.
examples.zh: 拍照片光线不够亮。

insult.definition: n. a deliberately offensive act or something producing the effect of deliberate disrespect
insult.translation: n. 侮辱, 无礼, 损害\nvt. 损害, 侮辱, 攻击

examples.en: There is no greater insult to life than premature ejaculation.
examples.zh: 没有什么比早泄更糟蹋生活的了

examples.en: I didn't mean to insult her.
examples.zh: 我没想冒犯她的。

examples.en: I didn't mean to insult anyone.
examples.zh: 我没有想要冒犯谁。

insurance.definition: n. promise of reimbursement in the case of loss; paid to people or companies so concerned about hazards that they have made prepayments to an insurance company
insurance.translation: n. 保险, 保险业, 保险费\n[医] 保险

examples.en: Cosmetic surgery is not covered by most insurance plans.
examples.zh: 大部份的保险计划不包含整容手术。

examples.en: In case the shipment is delayed, we have special delay insurance.
examples.zh: 万一船运迟了，我们有特别的迟到保险。

examples.en: The company medical treatment insurance covered all the medical treatment costs.
examples.zh: 公司的医疗保险覆盖了全部的医疗费用。

insure.translation: vt. 保险, 确保\nvi. 投保

examples.en: It's a crying shame that they weren't insured against fire.
examples.zh: 这简直是太可惜了，他们没有买火险。

examples.en: My house is fully insured.
examples.zh: 我的房子绝对保险。

intact.definition: s. (of a woman) having the hymen unbroken\ns. undamaged in any way
intact.translation: a. 尚未被人碰过的, 原封不动的, 完整的\n[医] 完整的, 无伤的

examples.en: You can write a sentence in a lot of ways and still keep the general message intact.
examples.zh: 同一个含义可以用很多不同方式写的句子来表示。

intake.definition: n. an opening through which fluid is admitted to a tube or container
intake.translation: n. 入口, 吸入, 吸入量\n[医] 摄取量

examples.en: Tom has been told to reduce his salt intake.
Ziri acclimated himself to the lower intake of oxygen.
Tom's doctor advised him to cut down on his sugar intake.

integral.definition: n. the result of a mathematical integration; F(x) is the integral of f(x) if dF/dx = f(x)\ns. constituting the undiminished entirety; lacking nothing essential especially not damaged\na. of or denoted by an integer
integral.translation: n. 整体, 积分, 整数\na. 固有的, 整体的, 整数的, 积分的\n[计] 积分

examples.en: The integral and the antiderivative are defined in two different ways, and the Fundamental Theorem of Calculus states the relationship between them.
examples.zh: 积分与反导函数是以两种不同的方式定义的，而微积分基本定理阐述了两者之间的关系。

integrate.definition: v. make into a whole or make part of a whole\nv. become one; become integrated\nv. calculate the integral of; calculate by integration
integrate.translation: vt. 综合, 使完整, 使成整体\nvi. 成一体\na. 完整的, 完全的

examples.en: They refuse to integrate.
examples.zh: 她们拒绝融入。

integrity.definition: n. an undivided or unbroken completeness or totality with nothing wanting\nn. moral soundness
integrity.translation: n. 正直, 廉正, 完整\n[计] 完整性

examples.en: In our society we find men of integrity along with crooks.
examples.zh: 我们的社会良莠不齐。

intellect.definition: n knowledge and intellectual ability\nn the capacity for rational thought or inference or discrimination\nn a person who uses the mind creatively
intellect.translation: n. 智力, 出众的才华, 知识分子\n[医] 智力, 才智

examples.en: Someone with a healthy human intellect would never do that.
Tom is weak now, but his intellect is sound.
Intellect is invisible to the man who has none.

intellectual.definition: n. a person who uses the mind creatively\ns. of or associated with or requiring the use of the mind\na. appealing to or using the intellect
intellectual.translation: n. 有知识者, 知识分子, 凭理智做事者\na. 智力的, 用脑力的, 聪明的

examples.en: In terms of intellectual hobbies, I really like learning Chinese characters.
examples.zh: 对知识的爱好而言，我真的喜欢学汉字。

examples.en: An intellectual is a person who has discovered something more interesting than sex.
examples.zh: 一个知识分子是发现到一种比性行为更有意思的活动的人。

examples.en: In my view, everyone should have intellectual hobbies as well as an interest in physical activities.
examples.zh: 对我自己来说，每个人应该有学知识的爱好，也应该对体育活动感兴趣。

intelligence.definition:
n. the ability to comprehend; to understand and profit from experience
n. a unit responsible for gathering and interpreting information about an enemy
n. secret information about an enemy (or potential enemy)
n. the operation of gathering information about an enemy
intelligence.translation: n. 智力, 情报, 信息\n[医] 智力

examples.en: To have doubts about oneself is the first sign of intelligence.
examples.zh: 自我怀疑是聪明的第一标志。

examples.en: His intelligence and experience enabled him to deal with the trouble.
examples.zh: 他的智慧和经验使他能处理这个麻烦。

examples.en: Your intelligence is as vast as the distance between Bombay and Mumbai.
examples.zh: 你的智慧广大的有如孟买和孟买之间的距离。

intelligent.definition: a. having the capacity for thought and reason especially to a high degree\ns. possessing sound knowledge\ns. endowed with the capacity to reason
intelligent.translation: a. 聪明的, 智能的, 了解的

examples.en: Jack is the most intelligent boy in the class.
examples.zh: 杰克是班里最聪明的男孩儿 。

examples.en: He is not as intelligent as his older brother.
examples.zh: 他不像他的兄长那样聪明。

examples.en: She was an intelligent woman with an erotic aura.
examples.zh: 她是一个有著性爱光环的聪明女人。

intend.definition: v. have in mind as a purpose\nv. design or destine
intend.translation: vt. 计划, 打算, 意思是\n[法] 想要, 打算, 意旨

examples.en: How long do you intend to stay here in Brazil?
examples.zh: 你打算在巴西待多久？

examples.en: I've woken up and I intend to prepare my breakfast.
examples.zh: 我醒来，打算准备早饭。

examples.en: I intend to study abroad in America next year.
examples.zh: 我打算明年去美国留学。

intense.definition: a. possessing or displaying a distinctive feature to a heightened degree\ns. (of color) having the highest saturation
intense.translation: a. 非常的, 强烈的, 紧张的, 热情的\n[医] 强的

examples.en: How are you keeping off this intense heat?
examples.zh: 你是怎么避开这酷暑的？

intensify.definition: v. make more intense, stronger, or more marked\nv. become more intense\nv. make the chemically affected part of (a negative) denser or more opaque in order produce a stronger contrast between light and dark

examples.en: The feelings of discomfort intensify every time I see you.
The argument between Tom and Mary began to intensify.
Continuing to eat while I talk will only intensify my disapproval.

intensity.definition: n. the amount of energy transmitted (as by acoustic or electromagnetic radiation)\nn. high level or degree; the property of being intense
intensity.translation: n. 强烈, 紧张, 强度\n[计] 强度; 亮度

examples.en: We were shocked by the intensity of our mother's anger.
He was dazzled by the intensity of the light.
He was overwhelmed by the intensity of her love.

intensive.definition: s. characterized by a high degree or intensity; often used as a combining form\na. tending to give force or emphasis\na. of agriculture; intended to increase productivity of a fixed area by expending more capital and labor
intensive.translation: a. 加强的, 内涵的, 集中的\nn. 加强器

examples.en: Some historical buildings in Algiers still need some intensive care.
The school's master's program is a one-year intensive study program.
He was in intensive care for almost two months.

intention.definition: n. (usually plural) the goal with respect to a marriage proposal\nn. an act of intending; a volition that you intend to carry out
intention.translation: n. 意图, 目的, 含义\n[医] 愈合, 意向

examples.en: I have no intention of telling you the result.
examples.zh: 我并不打算把结果告诉你。

examples.en: Tom had no intention of giving Mary any money.
examples.zh: 汤姆不想给玛丽一分钱。

examples.en: Tom has no intention of going to Mary's wedding.
examples.zh: 汤姆不打算去参加玛丽的婚礼。

intentional.definition: s. characterized by conscious design or purpose
intentional.translation: a. 故意的, 与目的有关的\n[法] 故意的, 有意的

examples.en: The opioid epidemic is intentional, a form of eugenics.
A person can't be that stupid. It has to be intentional.
The Arab Spring was not a mistake but an intentional mistake.

interact.definition: v. act together or towards others or with others
interact.translation: vi. 互相影响, 交互作用\nn. 幕间剧, 幕间休息

examples.en: You should interact with the local culture more, to better understand some traditions.
examples.zh: 你应该多接触本文化，多了解一些传统习俗。

interaction.definition: n. a mutual or reciprocal action; interacting\nn. (physics) the transfer of energy between elementary particles or between an elementary particle and a field or between fields; mediated by gauge bosons
interaction.translation: n. 交互作用, 交感\n[计] 交互作用

examples.en: All social interactions, naturally, will involve some degree of insincerity, which I believe is necessary.
examples.zh: 所有的社交，自然而然地，都会掺入一些虚伪的成分，我想这是有其必要的。

intercourse.translation: n. 交往, 交流\n[医] 交际, 往来

examples.en: Sami saw a girl having sexual intercourse with a dog.
Mary did not bleed in her first sexual intercourse with Tom.
Syphilis is an infection that can be transmitted through sexual intercourse.

interest.definition:
n. a sense of concern with and curiosity about someone or something
n. the power of attracting or holding one's attention (because it is unusual or exciting etc.)
n. a fixed charge for borrowing money; usually a percentage of the amount borrowed
n. (law) a right or legal share of something; a financial involvement with something
interest.translation: n. 兴趣, 嗜好, 利息, 利益, 爱好, 趣味, 势力\nvt. 使感兴趣, 与...有关系

examples.en: The article on Buddhism revived my interest in oriental religions.
examples.zh: 那篇关于佛教的文章再次勾起了我对东方宗教的兴趣。

examples.en: The money I have in the bank earns very low interest.
examples.zh: 我存在银行的钱利息非常低。

examples.en: Mary has an interest in Japanese language and history.
examples.zh: 玛丽对日语和日本历史感兴趣。

interfere.definition: v. come between so as to be hindrance or obstacle
interfere.translation: vi. 妨碍, 冲突, 干涉, 抵触\n[医] 干扰, 干涉, 阻碍, 碰腿(马)

examples.en: He has no right to interfere in our family affairs.
examples.zh: 他无权干涉我们的家庭事务。

examples.en: You have no right to interfere in other people's affairs.
examples.zh: 你没有干涉他人事务的权力。

examples.en: Don't interfere with matters that do not concern you!
examples.zh: 不要干预不关你的事！

interference.definition: n. (American football) blocking a player's path with your body
interference.translation: n. 冲突, 干涉\n[计] 干扰

examples.en: I won't allow you to continue your interference in my daughter's life.
examples.zh: 我不允许你继续干涉我女儿的生活。
